questions.q: Which instrument is used to draw a circle?
questions.explanation: A compass draws circles and arcs.

questions.q: The radius of a circle is the distance from ____.
options: the centre to outside the circle
one edge to the other through the centre
the centre to any point on the circle
one point on the circle to another
questions.explanation: All points on a circle are the same distance from the centre.

questions.q: If the radius of a circle is 5 cm, its diameter is ____.
What is the measure of each angle of a rectangle?
questions.explanation: All four angles of a rectangle are right angles.

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure an angle?
questions.explanation: A protractor measures angles in degrees.
